name: Inp-Video Ads Lite – Video Bubble & WhatsApp Marketing
author: Inp-web

sections.description:
Transform anonymous visitors into customers with the power of video.

Inp-Video Ads Lite is the ultimate lead generation tool that humanizes your WordPress site. Instead of a boring, static chat icon, you can now engage your audience with a personalized video greeting that follows them as they browse.

This interactive “Video Popup” creates an immediate bond of trust. When your visitors see a real person talking to them, your conversion rates skyrocket. Perfect for WooCommerce stores, professional portfolios, and landing pages where trust is the key to closing a sale.

Why Inp-Video Ads Lite?
* Human Connection: Show your face, your product, or your office to build instant credibility.
* Frictionless Sales: One click takes the user from your video directly to a WhatsApp chat with you.
* Modern Marketing: Use the same “Video Bubble” tech used by top-tier SaaS companies to capture leads 24/7.

Lite Version Features

  • Smart Video Bubble: A sleek, non-intrusive floating video that plays automatically on mute.
  • Direct WhatsApp Integration: A high-conversion CTA button that opens WhatsApp (Web or App) instantly.
  • Custom CTA Text: Adapt your call-to-action to your goal (e.g., “Get 10% Off”, “Talk to an Expert”, “Order via WhatsApp”).
  • Feather-Light Performance: Highly optimized code using native HTML5. No slow jQuery or heavy libraries.
  • Full Responsive Design: Looks and works perfectly on smartphones, tablets, and desktops.
  • Zero Conflict Guarantee: Built following the strictest WordPress.org coding standards.

Ready for more?
Looking for analytics, custom colors, multiple videos for different pages, and pro branding?
Check out Inp-Video PRO to take your video marketing to the elite level.
sections.installation:
1. Upload: Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and select the inp-video-ads-lite.zip file.
  2. Activate: Click “Activate” from the plugins page.
  3. Configure: Look for “Inp-Video Lite” in your admin sidebar. Enter your WhatsApp number (with country code), upload your .mp4, and you’re live!
sections.faq:
Does it work with WooCommerce?

Absolutely! It’s the perfect companion for WooCommerce, helping you solve customer doubts in real-time and reducing cart abandonment.

Will it slow down my site?

Not at all. We are developers obsessed with speed. The plugin loads asynchronously, meaning it won’t block your site’s rendering or hurt your Core Web Vitals.

What is the ideal video size?

For a lightning-fast experience, we recommend an .mp4 file between 1MB and 3MB. Short 15-30 second videos work best for engagement!

Can I customize the WhatsApp button?

Yes! You can change the button text to match your language or marketing strategy directly from the settings.
